answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The pearl cap is enforced at intake and voyage publishes the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a delta tag. That is 10 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
